issue_context.title: BrokerageSetupHandler fails when user FullName of algorithm
issue_context.body:
<!--- This template provides sections for bugs and features. Please delete any irrelevant sections before submitting -->

#### Expected Behavior
<!--- Required. Describe the behavior you expect to see for your case. -->
No error, should create algorithm instance by using either
- `FullName`, i.e. QuantConnect.Algorithm.CSharp.BasicTemplateAlgorithm
- `Name`, i.e. BasicTemplateAlgorithm

#### Actual Behavior
<!--- Required. Describe the actual behavior for your case. -->
`BrokerageSetupHandler` throws exception

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3648114/113925870-2b590200-97f4-11eb-87fb-03e747ea0a2f.png)


#### Potential Solution
<!--- Optional. Describe any potential solutions and/or thoughts as to what may be causing the difference between expected and actual behavior. -->
`Loader` uses `SingleOrAlgorithmTypeName` extension method to find algorithm, but put `.` in the start of search string, that cause the issue

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3648114/113926072-6bb88000-97f4-11eb-8c27-4d4110216b79.png)

#### Reproducing the Problem
<!--- Required for Bugs. Describe how to reproduce the problem. This can be via a failing unit test or a simplified algorithm that reliably demonstrates this issue.  -->
Use algorithm `FullName` to run Launcher

#### System Information
<!--- Required for Bugs. Include any system specific information, such as OS. -->
N\A
